events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
events.titleJa: Copilot Chat で Word・PowerPoint 内の画像テキスト検索を改善

events.summaryEn: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.
